messages:
ana: quick heads up: rolled out albatross-lite int4 canary -> seeing ~0.4% funcall schema failures where top-level 'args' is a quoted string instead of object. baseline fp32 ~0.02%. posting an example below.

rob: ouch. paste snippet?

ana: (typo) ana: sorry, snippet: 
```
RESPONSE: {"tool": "update_profile", "args": "{\"name\": \"Alex\", \"email\": \"a@x.com\"}"}
ERROR: schema.type_mismatch args expected OBJECT got STRING
```

meera: looks like the model returned a serialized JSON string for args. streaming or non-streaming?

ana: both, streaming slightly higher. repro set of 25 prompts in s3://redwood-canary/albatross-lite/quoted-args-repro/ sha256:fa12...

build-bot: artifact uploaded by ana: s3://redwood-canary/albatross-lite/quoted-args-repro/sha256:fa12...

leo: couple quick checks: are postproc versions identical? any new chunking/escape fixes?

ana: postproc is v2.2.0 on canary, baseline v2.1.3. runtime image has chunk-preserve flag enabled for int4 throughput.

rob: plan: (1) mirror fp32 on same runtime image to isolate kernel vs runtime, (2) add conservative non-destructive repair: if args is string and looks like JSON, try parse and set repair_meta, metric funcall_quoted_args_rate, (3) capture token ids+tokens for 1/50 failures.

meera: agreed. do not silently mutate in prod; always flag repair_meta and keep original_value. also gate canary: abort if quoted_args_rate > 0.2% sustained 30m.

ana: implemented 1/50 tracer and repair wrapper as opt-in flag. spinning mirror fp32 now, will post results.

leo: tagging tokenizers/runtime teams for deeper look (possible quote-splitting between chunks or rounding injecting 0x22).

rob: thumbs up. keep short repro batch and logs handy. check back in 45m. :thumbsup:
